notes.title: 2D Paintball Complete - Update!
notes.content:
We will be releasing an update to 2D Paintball Complete shortly to combat some bugs from feedback we've gathered during Early Access; most importantly a startup bug (whitescreen) a few users are encountering.

After this update your single player settings may be reset to default (lvl, name, colors, controls, loadout, settings, etc.) - in single player only - so you may need to change them again when you open the game. You may also get signed out of your online 2dpball account after the update, in which you may need to sign back in.

Hopefully this update addresses a few issues our users have run into. If you are experiencing any issues during Early access, please use the [ Contact Us / Feedback ] forms either in-game (home screen menu) or on our website @ www.2DPaintball.com

notes.title: 2D Paintball Complete - Live on Early Access!
notes.content:
Thanks to all online players for the past years, thank you beta testers, and thanks to the Early Access adopters. We look forward to Early access and continuing to build out the best 2D sim paintball game we possibly can!

If you are experiencing any issues during Early access, please use the [b][ Contact Us / Feedback ][/b] forms either in-game (home screen menu) or on our website @ www.2DPaintball.com

notes.title: Single player closed beta has started.
notes.content:
Beta testers are beginning to test the early access launch build. During early access we will continue porting the web/online game features and modes to the Steam / Single player EXE version (which will also include the online multiplayer in the client.)

In the mean time, you can play the F2P Online Alpha now @ [url=www.2dpaintball.com]www.2DPaintball.com[/url]!

notes.title: 2D Paintball v0.9.2 multiplayer alpha is live!
notes.content:
It's been a while, but we've been busy lately...
